# hosttracker_webhook (Data Source)

Reads one webhook, by id or by the address it delivers to.

The signing secret is not among the members: the API publishes its value only in the answer that mints it.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# By id.
data "hosttracker_webhook" "ops" {
  id = "0c3c7b07-cecb-43dd-9b76-8516d3b9c771"
}

# Or by the address it delivers to, which must match exactly one webhook.
data "hosttracker_webhook" "by_url" {
  lookup_url = "https://hooks.example.com/host-tracker"
}

output "ops_events" {
  value = data.hosttracker_webhook.ops.events
}

# How many monitors the scope resolved to - zero is worth alerting on.
output "ops_monitor_count" {
  value = data.hosttracker_webhook.ops.monitor_count
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) The webhook's id. Name it, or look the webhook up by `lookup_url`.
- `lookup_url` (String) Find the webhook by the address it POSTs to, matched exactly. The lookup must resolve to exactly one webhook.

### Read-Only

- `consecutive_failures` (Number) How many deliveries have failed in a row.
- `created` (Number) When the webhook was created, in Unix seconds.
- `disabled_reason` (String) Why the system switched this webhook off: `deliveryFailure` or `gone`. Null when the account switched it off, and when it is enabled.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether deliveries are attempted.
- `events` (Set of String) Which event types this webhook receives.
- `headers` (Attributes Set) The custom request headers every delivery carries. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--headers))
- `last_delivery_at` (Number) When a delivery was last attempted, in Unix seconds.
- `monitor_count` (Number) How many monitors the scope resolved to, including zero.
- `name` (String) The display name.
- `resolved_monitor_ids` (Set of String) Which monitors a `tags` scope resolved to.
- `scope` (Attributes) Which monitors this webhook receives events for - exactly one of the three forms. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--scope))
- `secret_set` (Boolean) Whether the webhook has a signing secret. The value itself is never readable.
- `secret_updated_at` (Number) When the current secret was minted, in Unix seconds.
- `updated` (Number) When the webhook was last edited, in Unix seconds.
- `url` (String) Where deliveries are POSTed.

<a id="nestedatt--headers"></a>
### Nested Schema for `headers`

Read-Only:

- `header` (String) The header name.
- `value` (String, Sensitive) The header value.


<a id="nestedatt--scope"></a>
### Nested Schema for `scope`

Read-Only:

- `all` (Boolean) Set when the webhook covers every monitor on the account.
- `monitor_ids` (Set of String) The explicit monitor list, when the scope is one.
- `tags` (Set of String) The tags matched, when the scope is a tag one.
